title: Hip fracture: initial, subsequent or history
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's hip fracture at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up of the left hip.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old female presenting for a routine postoperative evaluation six weeks following surgical repair of a closed femoral neck fracture. She is currently participating in physical therapy to regain mobility and strength. She reports that her progress is steady and she is managing well with her current rehabilitation program. She denies any significant new pain or concerns regarding the surgical site.

Medication List
Acetaminophen 650mg every 6 hours as needed for pain.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. She is currently ambulating with a walker. Examination of the left hip reveals stable surgical site with no signs of drainage or excessive erythema. Range of motion is improving. Neurovascular status of the left femur is intact.

Assessment
Status post surgical repair of a left femoral neck fracture. The patient is progressing well during the healing phase.

Plan
Continue current physical therapy regimen. Follow up in four weeks for continued monitoring of the left hip.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 10/14/2026
explanations: Closed fracture of the neck of the left femur, routine follow-up after surgery while it heals: 7th character D (no HCC): S72.002D.

distractors.why: Active treatment is complete; this is routine follow-up while it heals: 7th character D (no HCC).
The fracture is still healing; history is for a healed fracture.
